
🔐 Login Page UI
This is a simple, responsive Login Page user interface built using HTML and CSS. It features a smooth gradient background, modern form styling, and a complete flow including Register, Forgot Password, OTP Verification, and Reset Password screens.

📂 Project Structure
plaintext
Copy
Edit
├── index.html         # Login page
├── register.html      # Registration form
├── forgot.html        # Forgot password input
├── otp.html           # OTP verification
├── reset.html         # New password form
├── styles.css         # All UI styling
└── abstract-simple-colors-8k-1920x1080.jpg  # Optional background image
🖼️ Preview

(UI uses a gradient background by default. You can uncomment the image in CSS to use this.)

✨ Features
Stylish modern UI with Poppins font

Gradient background with blurred form card

Clean input fields with focus effect

Login form with "Remember me" & "Forgot Password"

Full flow for:

Registration

Forgot Password

OTP Verification

Password Reset

💻 Technologies Used
HTML5

CSS3

Google Fonts (Poppins)

Pure frontend (No JavaScript or backend)

🚀 How to Run
Download or clone this repo.

Open index.html in your browser.

Navigate between pages using links/buttons.

📌 Notes
You can enable the background image by uncommenting the relevant lines in styles.css.

The site is fully responsive and looks good on all screen sizes.

No form validation or backend connection is implemented.
